payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Abigail, In, Kayleen, Serina

payload.content:
Hi all — Abigail here. My availability is 4h, skills security 0.83 / devops 0.68. My cheapest feasible picks: ISSUE-0001::triage (3.07), ISSUE-0002::review (3.51), ISSUE-0001::review (3.84), ISSUE-0001::docs (3.84).

To maximize joint score (tasks completed + priority), I propose I take ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, good skill match, cost 3.51). Please reply with your intended pick so we avoid duplicates. If someone has a stronger claim on ISSUE-0002::review, I can fall back to ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::docs.

Kayleen here. My availability is 4h, top skill devops 0.77. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.77, ISSUE-0001::review 3.47, ISSUE-0001::docs 3.47, ISSUE-0001::test 5.05, ISSUE-0002::review 6.21, ISSUE-0002::test 8.90, ISSUE-0001::implement 8.93, ISSUE-0002::implement 14.43.

I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cheapest, cost 2.77). I am a poor fit for the medium ISSUE-0002 tasks (all costly for me), so I'd rather leave those to better-matched agents.

Abigail: you're cheaper than me on ISSUE-0002::review (3.51 vs 6.21), so please take it — I won't contest it. To maximize joint score we should cover all three medium ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) with whoever has the lowest cost, plus one low task. In and Serina: please post your intended picks and costs so we can avoid duplicates. I'll hold ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone has a stronger claim.

Abigail: Confirming intent — I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (medium priority, cost 3.51, good security/devops match). Kayleen, thanks, I'll take it as you suggested.

In and Serina: please post your intended pick + private cost. We want to cover as many tasks as possible without duplicates, prioritizing the 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) since they carry higher priority weight. I can consider ISSUE-0002::test (5.12) if someone is cheaper on review, or fall back to a low task (ISSUE-0001::triage 3.07 / review 3.84 / docs 3.84) if needed. Please state your claims so we avoid overlap. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Abigail (final plan): Locking in ISSUE-0002::review as my claim (medium priority weight 0.5, my cost 3.51, strong match on security+devops). Rationale: it's the best priority/cost tradeoff for me and Kayleen explicitly ceded it. I will NOT take ISSUE-0001::triage (Kayleen's claim). Fallback only if someone with an equal-or-better claim steps up: ISSUE-0002::test, else ISSUE-0001::docs. In / Serina — if either of you is cheap on ISSUE-0002::implement or ::test, please take those to cover the remaining medium tasks; I'll stay on review to keep us duplicate-free. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Kayleen (planning, iter=1): Confirming my claim = ISSUE-0001::triage (low priority, cost 2.77, effort 2.4 fits my 4h availability, devops match). 

Reasoning for joint score: my medium ISSUE-0002 costs are poor (review 6.21, test 8.90, implement 14.43 — implement overloads my 4h availability), so I add little value there. Abigail is cheaper on ISSUE-0002::review (3.51 vs my 6.21) and ::test (5.12 vs my 8.90), so she should keep review. I will NOT contest any ISSUE-0002 task.

In and Serina: please post your intended pick + private cost ASAP. We have 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) worth more priority weight — if either of you is cheap on implement or test, take them so we cover all three mediums plus one low (mine). If you are both expensive on the mediums, say so and I can reconsider taking one medium instead of triage to avoid leaving a higher-priority task uncovered. No duplicates please.

Abigail (planning, iter=1) — proposed allocation to maximize joint score (cover all 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low):
- Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.51, medium, security+devops match)
- Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.77, low)
- In → ISSUE-0002::implement (medium) if you're cheap on devops/security
- Serina → ISSUE-0002::test (medium) if you're cheap

In / Serina: please post your intended pick + private cost. If you're both expensive on the mediums, say so — then I can flex to ISSUE-0002::test (5.12) and one of you can take a low task, but priority-wise covering the mediums is better. I will hold ISSUE-0002::review unless someone has a strictly better claim. No duplicates.

Kayleen (planning, iter=1) — FINAL PLAN: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (low, cost 2.77, effort 2.4 ≤ my 4h availability, devops 0.77 match). I will NOT contest any ISSUE-0002 task (my costs there are poor: review 6.21, test 8.90, implement 14.43).

Current agreed map:
- Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (3.51)
- Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (2.77)
- In → ISSUE-0002::implement (medium) if cheap on devops/security
- Serina → ISSUE-0002::test (medium) if cheap

In / Serina: please post your intended pick + private cost so we lock a duplicate-free allocation. If neither of you can cheaply cover ISSUE-0002::implement, note that implement (effort 6.0) overloads a 4h availability and will be costly for most — in that case we still complete 3 tasks (2 medium + 1 low) which is fine. I hold triage unless someone has a strictly stronger claim.

In here. Availability 10h, top skills security 0.99 / devops 0.93. Private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.32, ISSUE-0002::review 2.83, ISSUE-0001::review 2.90, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.90, ISSUE-0002::test 3.96, ISSUE-0001::test 4.06, ISSUE-0002::implement 5.66, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.80.

KEY POINT: I have 10h availability, so effort-6.0 ISSUE-0002::implement does NOT overload me (cost 5.66). For 4h-availability agents, implement overloads and is very costly (Kayleen 14.43). So I have a clear comparative advantage on the medium implement task.

INTENT: I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (medium priority, cost 5.66, strong devops+security match). This lets us cover all 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low:
- In → ISSUE-0002::implement (5.66)
- Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (3.51)
- Serina → ISSUE-0002::test
- Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (2.77)
Priority sum = 1.75, 4 tasks, no duplicates. I will NOT contest review/triage. Abigail: hold review. Kayleen: hold triage. Serina: please post your cost for ISSUE-0002::test; if you're expensive there, I can flex to test and you/Abigail cover implement.

Abigail (planning, iter=1) — FINAL: I lock ISSUE-0002::review (medium, cost 3.51, effort 3.0 ≤ my 4h, security 0.83/devops 0.68 match). Rationale: after In takes implement, I'm the cheapest of the remaining agents on review (3.51 vs Kayleen 6.21), so this maximizes coverage while minimizing cost. I will NOT touch triage (Kayleen's) or implement (In's).

Agreed duplicate-free map (covers all 3 mediums + 1 low, priority_sum 1.75):
- In → ISSUE-0002::implement (5.66)
- Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (3.51)
- Serina → ISSUE-0002::test
- Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (2.77)

Serina: still need your pick + private cost. If you are expensive on ISSUE-0002::test, say so and I will flex to ::test (5.12) and you take a low task (e.g. ISSUE-0001::docs/review) — but only if that lowers total cost. Otherwise I hold review. Everyone: no duplicates, and please do NOT skip if you can cheaply cover a remaining task.

Kayleen (planning, iter=1) — LOCKED. I claim ISSUE-0001::triage (low, cost 2.77, effort 2.4 ≤ my 4h, devops 0.77). I will not contest any ISSUE-0002 task. Agreed duplicate-free map stands: In → ISSUE-0002::implement (5.66), Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (3.51), Serina → ISSUE-0002::test, Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (2.77). Serina: please post your cost for ISSUE-0002::test; if you can't cover it, tell us so we can flex (Abigail could take test and one of us a low task), but I hold triage regardless. No duplicates.

In (planning, iter=1) — FINAL/LOCKED: I claim ISSUE-0002::implement (medium, cost 5.66, effort 6.0 ≤ my 10h availability, security 0.99/devops 0.93 match).

Why me on implement: implement (effort 6.0) overloads 4h-availability agents (Kayleen 14.43), so the cheapest-cover for it is me. I will NOT contest review or triage.

Confirmed duplicate-free map (covers all 3 mediums + 1 low, priority_sum 1.75, 4 tasks):
- In → ISSUE-0002::implement (5.66)
- Abigail → ISSUE-0002::review (3.51)
- Serina → ISSUE-0002::test
- Kayleen → ISSUE-0001::triage (2.77)

Serina: please confirm ISSUE-0002::test with your cost. If you are expensive there, tell us and I will flex to ISSUE-0002::test (3.96) and you take implement only if your implement cost < 5.66; otherwise we keep this map. No duplicates, please don't skip if you can cheaply cover a remaining task.
